questions.haul_item: What equipment will you be hauling (e.g. skid steer, mini excavator, tractor)?
questions.payload_capacity: What's the rough total weight of the load?
questions.length: About how long is the load (or what deck length do you need)?
questions.hitch_type: Do you prefer a bumper pull or gooseneck hitch?
questions.loading_style: How will you load it — ramps, deckover, or drive-over fenders?

answer_guidance.haul_item: Store the equipment or machinery the customer says they are hauling. Accept short noun phrases or free-form item descriptions.
answer_guidance.payload_capacity: Store the rough total load weight or payload requirement. Accept pounds, lbs, tons, or equivalent weight wording only.
answer_guidance.length: Store the load length or desired deck length. Accept feet, inches, or clear size shorthand when length is being answered.
answer_guidance.hitch_type: Store only bumper pull or gooseneck when the customer explicitly chooses a hitch preference.
answer_guidance.loading_style: Store how the customer wants to load the equipment, such as ramps, deckover, or drive-over fenders.

questions.haul_item: What type of vehicle will you be hauling (make/model or class)?
questions.payload_capacity: What's the approximate weight of the vehicle?
questions.length: About how long is the vehicle?
questions.open_vs_covered: Are you looking for an open car hauler or a covered/enclosed option?

answer_guidance.haul_item: Store the vehicle make/model, class, or type the customer wants to haul.
answer_guidance.payload_capacity: Store the approximate vehicle weight or payload requirement using weight units only.
answer_guidance.length: Store the vehicle length or required deck length. Accept feet, inches, or clear size shorthand when answering length.
answer_guidance.open_vs_covered: Store whether the customer wants an open car hauler or a covered/enclosed option.

questions.haul_item: What will you be hauling on the utility trailer?
questions.payload_capacity: What's the rough total weight of your load?
questions.trailer_size: Do you have a size preference (length / width)?

answer_guidance.haul_item: Store the cargo, equipment, or use case the customer says they need the utility trailer for.
answer_guidance.payload_capacity: Store the rough total load weight or payload requirement using weight units only.
answer_guidance.trailer_size: Store the preferred trailer dimensions. Accept length, width, or combined size notation such as AxB or AxBxC when clearly giving size.

Utility.notes: Never ask the customer for an axle capacity here - it is not a qualification question for utility trailers; if they volunteer one it is still stored and used for ranking.

questions.haul_item: What material will you be hauling (dirt, gravel, debris, etc.)?
questions.payload_capacity: What's the rough haul weight per load?
questions.dump_mechanism: Do you have a preference for the dump mechanism — scissor lift, telescopic, or standard?

answer_guidance.haul_item: Store the material or debris the customer says they will haul, such as dirt, gravel, rock, mulch, or construction debris.
answer_guidance.payload_capacity: Store the rough haul weight per load or payload requirement using weight units only.
answer_guidance.dump_mechanism: Store the preferred dump mechanism such as scissor lift, telescopic, or standard.

questions.haul_item: What will you be hauling on the tilt trailer?
questions.payload_capacity: What's the approximate weight of the load?
questions.tilt_style: Would you prefer a full-tilt deck or one with a stationary front section?

answer_guidance.haul_item: Store what the customer plans to haul on the tilt trailer.
answer_guidance.payload_capacity: Store the approximate load weight or payload requirement using weight units only.
answer_guidance.tilt_style: Store the preferred tilt configuration such as full tilt or stationary front section.

questions.haul_item: What will you be using the enclosed trailer for (cargo hauling, mobile workshop, etc.)?
questions.cargo_size: What's the rough size of the cargo you need to fit (length × width × height)?
questions.ac_windows_cabinets: Will you need AC, windows, or cabinets inside?
questions.finished_interior: Does the interior need to be finished (e.g. lined walls, flooring)?

answer_guidance.haul_item: Store the enclosed-trailer use case such as cargo hauling, workshop, vending, or similar.
answer_guidance.cargo_size: Store the cargo dimensions or required interior fit. Accept length, width, height, inches, or size shorthand such as AxB or AxBxC.
answer_guidance.ac_windows_cabinets: Store whether the customer wants interior amenities like AC, windows, cabinets, or similar.
answer_guidance.finished_interior: Store whether the customer wants a finished interior such as lined walls or finished flooring.

questions.length: What length of concession trailer are you looking for?
questions.ac_windows_cabinets: Will you need a serving window, AC, or cabinets fitted?
questions.finished_interior: Does the interior need to be finished out (lined walls, flooring, counters)?

answer_guidance.length: Store the trailer length in feet. Accept a range or a size shorthand such as 8.5x14 and take the LENGTH from it.
answer_guidance.ac_windows_cabinets: Store requested fit-out items such as a serving window, AC, or cabinets.
answer_guidance.finished_interior: Store whether the customer wants a finished interior such as lined walls, flooring, or counters.

Concession.notes: Concession trailers are an Enclosed body fitted out for vending.

questions.length: What trailer length are you looking for?
questions.gate_preferences: Any preference on gate style — butterfly, swing, or slant load?

answer_guidance.length: Store the requested trailer length. Accept feet, inches, or clear length shorthand when length is being answered.
answer_guidance.gate_preferences: Store any gate-style preference the customer explicitly requests.

Livestock.notes: Do NOT ask about animal type or count. Only ask about trailer length.

questions.bin_size: What size bins are you needing (e.g. 10 yd, 20 yd)?
questions.deck_style: Do you prefer a step-deck or standard deck?
questions.cdl_concern: Is staying under CDL weight thresholds a concern for you?

answer_guidance.bin_size: Store the requested bin size in cubic yards, such as 10 yd or 20 yd; for a range, use the smallest value. A bin and the trailer under it are one fact, off by one - a 10 yd bin rides a 9 ft trailer - so a length answers this question too, and Python works out the other number for the search.
answer_guidance.deck_style: Store the preferred deck style such as step deck or standard deck.
answer_guidance.cdl_concern: Store whether staying under CDL-related limits matters to the customer.

Aluminum.notes: Aluminum is the primary inventory category. Store the underlying trailer type in base_category and map it to the subcategory filter.

cargo_traits.label: Light load
cargo_traits.definition: Cargo at or under about 1,500 lbs - light enough that any trailer in the category carries it.

cargo_traits.label: Large / heavy cargo
cargo_traits.definition: Large, wide, heavy-duty or vehicle cargo - the trailer has to be wide enough for it.

rules.reason: light load - any utility trailer carries it

rules.question: About how wide is that item or trailer you need to haul?
rules.reason: large cargo - the trailer has to be wide enough
